name: 黄金の裁断・単体の剣弧
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Reinterpret the supplied real Color Resonance reference assets into ONE original transparent VFX master for the learned single-enemy technique 黄金の裁断 (spinel_verdict). Reference 1 is the actual existing golden thrust: use only its warm amber/gold/pearl color identity and clean illustrated light finish, NOT its straight projectile or faceted spear shape. Reference 2 is the actual area golden spell: use only its strong simple white/gold value grouping, NOT its diamond, star or explosion shape. Reference 3 is the real heart sword: use its pearl-white light identity only; no hilt or literal weapon drawing. The new technique is a sword CUT at one enemy, not a thrust, area burst or armor-fracture scene.
Create one 1536 x 1024 true-transparent RGBA canvas. Exactly ONE slim upright CURVED sword-cut band, like a clean shallow parenthesis opening to the LEFT: continuous white-gold cutting arc bends toward the right around mid-height, tapering gently to rounded smooth tips at the top and bottom. Center its overall contour near (768,512), about 640px high and 320px wide, leaving at least220px fully transparent margin on each side. The band width is about65px at its broadest middle section. One filled continuous band with a pearl-white broad inner core, warm soft gold main body, and a modest medium amber outer contour so it can read on a bright floor. Only2–3 broad smoothly shaded cel-color areas; no parallel trim lines, cracked facets, tessellation, runes or noisy texture. Preserve a clear open left-side negative space; no second arc or closed circle. Robust simple contour when later resized to roughly120px tall; no isolated tips or tiny specks. Calm clean game illustration, a decisive short cutting stroke rather than violent tearing. True alpha-zero background and padding, no outside bloom cloud or fog.
No character, face, hand, enemy silhouette, body pixels, wound, gore, erasure, helmet, shell, fracture, shard, star, sparkle, particle, arrowhead, projectile, spear, diamond, giant sword model, halo, area ring, floor painting, ground, platform, backdrop, text, letters, numbers, symbol, border, checkerboard or watermark. Exactly the ONE simple shallow curved filled gold cutting band.
髪は全て透過せず、下位レイヤーを描写しない
髪の不透明度は100％とする
intricate textures（複雑な質感）の要素は抑えめにし、過剰な微細描写、エッジノイズ、粒状のきらめき、鱗状の模様、等間隔に繰り返す細かな波打ちを避け、全体になめらかで清潔感のある質感を強調してください。
